items.quote: Perhaps the most familiar authentication option, basic auth (as it is often called) requires an Agent to provide a username and password for a request.
items.why: Quote names basic auth as an auth method requiring username and password.

items.quote: To create and use an API token, your user must have the API User permission.
items.why: Confirms API User permission for tokens, but nothing on basic auth format or environments.

items.quote: API tokens are required to use Gladly APIs for security and authentication purposes.
items.why: Says tokens are required for security; says nothing about who can get them or customer gating.

items.quote: The integration partner should provide the email address to be used with the integration's user account in Gladly.
items.why: Shows a partner supplies the integration user's email; no mention of paying customers or sales-led access.
